technique_name: What can be done to improve cross-cultural communication?
description: There are a number of things that can be done to improve cross-cultural communication. Firstly, strive to understand the culture of the person you are communicating with, such as their values and communication style. This can help you to appreciate their culture and better understand where they are coming from. Secondly, act with respect and courtesy, being sensitive to different social norms.
